Three USB-C ports each deliver up to 100W, so you can power a MacBook and other devices at the same time.
A large 25000mAh capacity carries your devices through several recharges, and 100W ultra-fast input brings the power bank back to 30% in just 20 minutes.
One USB-C cable extends up to 2.3 ft and is rated for over 20000 retractions, while a second 0.98 ft cable doubles as a carrying strap tested for more than 20000 bends.
The two built-in USB-C cables, one USB-A port and one USB-C port let you connect up to four smartphones, tablets or other USB devices together.
Anker Power Bank (25K, 165W, Built-In and Retractable Cables), user manual and a 12-month warranty.
